summary: This note describes ESPN College Basketball on ABC, the branding used for ESPN-produced broadcasts of NCAA Division I college basketball games on the American Broadcasting Company. ABC aired select college basketball games in the 1960s and 1970s before regular televising began on January 18, 1987. ABC's final regular college basketball broadcast aired on March 7, 2009.
one_line: ESPN-produced NCAA Division I college basketball broadcasts on ABC, running from regular coverage in 1987 to the final broadcast in 2009.
key_facts: ESPN College Basketball on ABC was originally branded as College Basketball on ABC.
The branding was used for broadcasts of NCAA Division I college basketball games produced by ESPN and televised on ABC.
ABC broadcast select college basketball games during the 1960s and 1970s.
ABC began televising college basketball on a regular basis on January 18, 1987.
The first regular-season ABC college basketball game in 1987 involved the LSU Tigers and Kentucky Wildcats.
CBS and NBC were also broadcasting college games at the time of ABC's 1987 expansion.
The 1987 ABC expansion put college basketball on all three major broadcast television networks.
ABC's final regular college basketball broadcast aired on March 7, 2009.
The final ABC regular college basketball broadcast was a game between the Oklahoma State Cowboys and Oklahoma Sooners.
The branding is described in the note as formerly used, meaning it is no longer in use.
